Grid 6 by 6. Zero-based ( row , col ). Rows increase down; columns increase right. Start ( 5 , 0 ). Goal ( 4 , 2 ). Obstacles ( 0 , 1 ).

Candidate: left right up jump right right
Feedback: invalid | step=1 | reason=out_of_bounds
